overview.officialSectionNumbering: The official site does not expose simple numeric stage numbers. This research assigns stable synthetic order labels N1-N8, M1-M8, S1-S9, and K1-K10 based on official subtrail page order.
overview.routeType: multi-section hiking trail with branched inland routes and an emerging coastal route
countyAndRegion: Skåne County at the Båstad station coastal endpoint
connection northward toward Bohusleden/Västra Götaland at Älvsåker
overview.officialCollaboration: The official footer describes Hallandsleden as a collaboration between Laholm, Halmstad, Hylte, Falkenberg, Varberg, Kungsbacka and Region Halland.

officialMapAndGeometrySources.hoodinApi: The official site uses Hoodin API endpoints for tracks, track-segments, and places. Keep as research evidence; do not rely on the token or endpoint shape for production import without a later approved integration pass.
officialMapAndGeometrySources.lineworkCaveat: On 2026-04-29, several official map API section records had empty line geometry even though official GPX downloads existed. These require GPX parsing or alternate geometry verification during section research.

subtrails.name: Norra delleden
subtrails.title: Norra - inland
subtrails.note: Kungsbacka-Varberg inland. The northern inland trail meets Bohusleden at Älvsåker and splits at Åkulla Bokskogar toward Varberg or onward to Åkulla/Ästad.

subtrails.name: Mellersta delleden
subtrails.title: Mellersta - inland
subtrails.note: Falkenberg-Hylte inland. At Åkulla/Ästad the inland trail has an eastern line via Ullared toward Kvarnforsen and a western line via Ätradalen toward Frodeparken.

subtrails.name: Södra delleden
subtrails.title: Södra - inland
subtrails.note: Halmstad-Laholm inland. South of/north of Simlångsdalen the trail splits around Gyltige, with western/eastern approaches before continuing toward Koarp and Skåneleden.

subtrails.name: Kusten
subtrails.title: Kusten
subtrails.note: Coastal Hallandsleden. The official site says the coastal line is being built in stages; Kungsbacka and Båstad/Laholm-Halmstad/Steninge sections are available, while Falkenberg and Varberg coastal gaps are expected to be added during 2026-2027.

branchesAndConnections: Northern inland route connects to Bohusleden at Älvsåker and branches in/near Åkulla between Varberg and Åkulla/Ästad alignments.
Mellersta inland route has eastern and western alternatives: Åkulla-Ullared-Kvarnforsen and Ästad-Vessigebro-Frodeparken.
Southern inland route has separate approaches around Gyltige/Simlångsdalen, then continues toward Koarp where it meets Skåneleden.
Coastal Hallandsleden is incomplete as a continuous coastal line; official text says sections through Falkenberg and Varberg are planned to be added during 2026-2027.

ferriesRowboatsTransfers.overviewFinding: No whole-trail ferry, rowboat, or required bus-transfer dependency was confirmed in the Phase 1 overview pass. Each section still needs transit/access and field-report verification.

rulesAndAccessOverview.fire: Official important-information page says to check current fire rules in dry conditions, use established fireplaces along the trail, and ensure fires are extinguished. It links to MSB Brandrisk Ute. Current fire bans are date-sensitive and must be checked per municipality/date before import copy claims anything current.
rulesAndAccessOverview.allemansratten: Official important-information page emphasizes general right-of-public-access principles: do not disturb or destroy, avoid growing crops, and respect home privacy zones.
rulesAndAccessOverview.dogs: Official dog page says dogs can be brought, but must be leashed or under strict supervision during 1 March-20 August; special rules can apply on beaches and in nature/culture reserves. It also allows overnighting with dogs at shelters if under supervision and not disturbing other hikers.
rulesAndAccessOverview.water: Official important-information page highlights drinking water at Nösslinge kyrka and notes the nearby Gällarpesjön shelter lacks drinking water. Summer wells can be dry/unreliable according to the dog-equipment page.
rulesAndAccessOverview.currentness: Official important-information page says updated 2025-04-15. Official reroute page says updated 2024-11-07. Digital map is current for 2024 reroutes; paper maps printed June 2022 contain old alignments.
rulesAndAccessOverview.diseaseBiosecurity: Official important-information page includes African swine fever guidance: take food waste home or put it in bins, do not leave food scraps in nature, and report sick/dead wild boar to SVA.
rulesAndAccessOverview.reserves: Many sections pass through or near nature reserves. Reserve-specific rules, dog restrictions, camping/fire restrictions, and access rules need section-level verification from Länsstyrelsen/municipality pages.

currentnessRisksAndContradictions.finding: The live official site/API on 2026-04-29 support 612 km, 4 subtrails, and 35 current sections. Older external pages and snippets may still describe Hallandsleden as about 435 km / 26 stages / 3 parts; treat those as stale unless they have a newer publication date.
currentnessRisksAndContradictions.importImpact: Use the live official section inventory for candidate research; record older figures only as contradictions/stale-source risks.

currentnessRisksAndContradictions.finding: Official reroute page says 2024 reroutes are reflected in the digital map but not in paper maps printed June 2022.
currentnessRisksAndContradictions.importImpact: Prefer official digital map/GPX over older scanned or paper-map-derived geometry. Mark affected sections for geometry verification.

currentnessRisksAndContradictions.finding: Several sections have official GPX download links but no line coordinates in the official map API response on 2026-04-29.
currentnessRisksAndContradictions.importImpact: Route geometry should parse the official GPX, compare endpoints with section pages and OSM/Naturkartan, and not treat empty API linework as missing official geometry.
